scope: Read-only audit through 2026-10-23; no configuration or result pointers changed

main_policy.description: First reject both-opposing Nifty slot/session directions. Reject long when VIX session and recent changes are both >=2%; reject short when both <=-2%. Early full-lookback shortage uses session change.
main_policy.selection_basis: Explicit user adoption on 2026-10-23 after reviewing 5-minute versus 30-minute results

shock_policy.trigger: abs(VIX 5-minute return)>=1.0% OR (trade-signed Nifty slot return<=-0.05% AND trade-signed Nifty session return>=0.10%)
shock_policy.action: Initial SL=1.20%*0.875=1.05%; target=original slot target*0.5. Other regimes retain baseline exits. Existing timed tightening retained.
shock_policy.status: Exploratory risk candidate; automatic development/validation selection retained original exits

selection_history.interpretation: Splits restrict direct look-ahead in each experiment but reused entry rules, targets, repeated trials, and later manual choice mean none of the historical months is a clean whole-strategy out-of-sample test. Do not label October an untouched holdout.
selection_history.automatic_selection_result: G8 selection research and past-only research latest pointers retained baseline_nifty. Adopted main30m policy was a later manual user choice.
selection_history.october23: Existing fixed parameters replayed; no new parameter fit to this day. One day alone is not validation.

analytical_interpretation: October has materially lower per-trade success, particularly shorts. It does not have the largest losing-day fraction: G8 October2/14=14.29%, versus August3/19=15.79%.
Entry-time VIX is higher in October, but trade-signed Nifty slot/session alignment is stronger too; plain disagreement with Nifty is not a sufficient explanation.
The G8 normal_mixed category worsens from September80.28% win rate on71 trades to October43.48% on23 trades. High VIX alone cannot explain all losses.
October baseline losers averaged0.388% positive excursion before exit. This is a retrospective exit-efficiency diagnostic, not an entry feature or proof that a tighter target improves total P&L.
Shock exits improve October by4 wins and7521.43 rupees but reduce profits in each earlier month. This is evidence for a measured tradeoff, not a universal remedy.
G3..G8 share entry ancestry, so cross-version deterioration is correlated, not independent evidence of the same external cause.
